text:
Nora (Partnerships): Quick sync: Sapphire Systems + integrator Orion want to go live on marketplace next Friday. Need final guidance on public vs private artifacts and an upload owner. @Dan @Claire any immediate blockers?
Dan (Security): Public: 1-paragraph SOC2 extract and a redacted pen-test executive summary only. Private bundle: full SOC2, raw vuln scans, firmware debug logs, and cert chains. No private keys or PII.
Claire (Marketplace): We require a signed attestation PDF for the listing and presigned links for reviewers (7-14 days). Prefer concise filenames under a public/ folder. Who will own uploads and verification?
Omar (HW SI): Orion can produce a firmware SHA256 file, a redacted SBOM, and a sanitized patch timeline. They asked if we can show a public "firmware-hash.txt" and a private HSM attestation blob.
Dan (Security): Firmware hash OK publicly. HSM attestation blobs go private. Strip serials, device UUIDs, ARNs, account IDs, and any customer-identifying fields. Add a short redaction note at the top of each redacted doc.
Nora (Partnerships): Zoe, legal: any required attestation wording constraints? Sapphire wants to state "image signed" on the listing. How to phrase safely?
Zoe (Legal): Keep statements factual and time-bounded: e.g., "Firmware version 4.2 signed on 2026-03-15 using Sapphire-managed signing key." Avoid guarantees. Use our marketplace attestation template; Orion must sign.
presign-bot: preflight OK. Upload prefix: `s3://redwood-marketplace/evidence/sapphire-orion-2026-03/`. Presign TTL options: 604800 (7d) or 1209600 (14d). Example: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace/evidence/sapphire-orion-2026-03/<file> --expires-in 1209600`.
Claire (Marketplace): Suggested public manifest:
- public/soc2-extract.pdf (1 page, redacted)
- public/pen-test-summary.pdf (redacted)
- public/firmware-hash.txt (sha256 only)
- public/attestation-marketplace.pdf (signed)
Private bundle (presigned):
- private/full-soc2.pdf
- private/pen-test-full.pdf
- private/hsm-attestation.b64
- private/evidence-index.txt (filenames + short descriptions)

Omar (HW SI): Orion will run a scrub CI step to strip serials and hostnames before upload. We'll produce public firmware-hash.txt and a redacted SBOM excerpt (vendor names only).
Dan (Security): Redaction checklist: remove serials, IPs, MACs, customer names/emails, private keys, PKCS#12 files, exact commit SHAs that map to customers. If in doubt, redact the paragraph.
Nora (Partnerships): Owners & deadlines: Orion upload to presign path Tue EOD (Omar lead); Zoe to issue attestation template Wed AM; Dan to do redaction review Wed PM; Claire to generate presigns Thu AM; Partnerships to finalize listing copy Thu PM. Primary review contact: Nora, backup Omar.
Claire (Marketplace): I'll post presign links and a short reviewer checklist here once ready. Please ensure filenames match the manifest.
Zoe (Legal): Attestation template -> https://redwood.internal/legal/templates/marketplace_attestation_hw_v2.pdf
Omar (HW SI): We'll automate the scrub and upload pipeline.
Dan (Security): Reminder: raw scanner outputs stay private only. No raw Nmap/Nessus on public or shared links.
Nora (Partnerships): Thanks team. If we hit deadlines we can still hit Friday announcement. Ping here for any slips. :thumbsup:
